abstract: The suction gripper has a suction connection supported by a suction plate (5) fitted with a sealing profile (8). The suction plate has in the region of its edge (6) fasteners which project over the surface of the top and bottom sides of the suction plate whereby the sealing profile which is to be pushed onto the edge of the suction plate is pushed over the fasteners.
